title: INC-9696: incident on the Edge Proxy Layer
body:
Impact

The Edge Proxy Layer incident described here is closed at
the time of writing. Release Management linked roughly 34
tickets to the event and engaged Tessaro Labs, the hosting
provider, within the first hour.

Timeline

Omar Haddad logged the following events, state as of 28
October 2025:
* The on-call engineer confirmed failed health checks on two
  nodes
* A configuration push was identified as the likely trigger
* The vendor was engaged through the premium support line

Status

Release Management lists the incident as closed. Report
written by Ivan Petrov on 9 June 2025; the next review falls
in the 20:00-21:00 UTC window and goes to the weekly service
meeting.
